definitions.gloss: blasting, demolition by explosion, blowing up
definitions.explanation: Destroying something by means of explosives. Used for controlled demolition of buildings, mining operations, and military or criminal destruction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{爆破|ばくは}⟦{解体|かいたい}→解体：06223_kaitai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The old building was demolished by controlled explosion.

examples.japanese: {爆破|ばくは}⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{封鎖|ふうさ}→封鎖：18846_fuusa⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A bomb threat was made, and the surrounding area was sealed off.

examples.japanese: ⟦ダム→ダム：00034_damu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{爆破|ばくは}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: To build the dam, blasting work was carried out to remove rock from part of the mountain.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as a noun and suru-verb ({爆破|ばくは}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Used for both controlled demolition ({爆破|ばくは}⟦{解体|かいたい}→解体：06223_kaitai⟧) and criminal/military destruction. In news reports, {爆破|ばくは}⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧ (bomb threat) is a frequently seen compound.

Compared to ⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧ (explosion), {爆破|ばくは} emphasizes the intentional act of destroying something with explosives, while ⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧ focuses on the explosion event itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆破|ばくは}⟦{解体|かいたい}→解体：06223_kaitai⟧: demolition by explosion
- {爆破|ばくは}⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧: bomb threat
- {爆破|ばくは}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: bombing incident
- {爆破|ばくは}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to blow up, to blast
- {発破|はっぱ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to set a blast charge (related term)
